name: What are the common signs of a gas line leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a gas line leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a gas line leak include a distinct sulfur-like or rotten egg smell, often due to an additive called mercaptan. You might also hear a hissing or whistling sound near a gas line, see dying vegetation over an underground line, or observe bubbles in a puddle near the line. Physical symptoms like dizziness, nausea, or fatigue when near a gas source can also indicate a leak. If you notice any of these signs, evacuate the area immediately and contact Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC for emergency repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a gas leak include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, dying plants, or bubbles near gas lines. If you notice these, evacuate and call a professional.
